note: Mostly acoustic maloya of the kabar and the revival: Firmin Viry's 1976 Communist Party records, the Ocora and Bourbon Maloya field-style recordings, Granmoun Lélé, Gramoun Bébé and Danyèl Waro, then Salem, Lindigo and Zanmari Baré. Ziskakan and Alain Péters stand for the band and electric side; electronic maloya is left out.

size.basis: No source counts recordings. French Wikipedia says most Réunion musicians and groups use maloya and lists about 25; Granmoun Lélé alone left more than 200 titles; Ziskakan made six local albums in the 1980s; the Bourbon Maloya compilation holds 65 tracks by about 35 performers. Recording began only in 1972 and the genre was banned until 1981, so the catalogue is mostly from 1976 onward, largely local CDs from labels such as Discorama, Oasis, Piros and Cobalt. An insider's essential list is about 40 tracks.
